sources.title: Deep MedChem — CHEESE: AI Virtual Screening Across 40T+ Molecules
sources.snippet: Deep MedChem is a spin-off from The MAMA AI and i&i Prague—a startup investor and incubator connected with IOCB, a top-class medicinal chemistry institution in Europe. The collaboration led to the development of CHEESE platform—a family of AI products for drug discovery that accelerate the early phases of drug discovery.
